batches.notes: Four deployment strategy implementations moved byte-identically; legacy module imports are shims.
Seven context-domain implementations moved byte-identically; plural namespace remains a shim.
Fifty-one application modules moved byte-identically to skeleton/app/runtime/; legacy skeleton/application modules are compatibility shims.
Seven persistence primitive modules moved byte-identically to skeleton/persistence/core/; skeleton/persist remains compatibility-only.
Runtime Python moved under skeleton/automation, embedded assurance tests moved to tests/shift_supervisor, and human docs moved to docs/operations/shift-supervisor.
Canonical implementation pre-existed under skeleton/security; the top-level core file is already a compatibility entrypoint.
Architecture index and rounds 3-22 moved into a cohesive foundation/architecture namespace; legacy root modules remain compatibility shims, and the canonical index imports canonical round modules.

The optional JVM accelerator registry moved byte-identically beside native runtime ownership. The root module is now a compatibility shim; the canonical AI runtime mirror remains byte-identical and its mapping source now follows skeleton/native/jvm_registry.py. The separate java-accelerators/ implementation root remains unchanged.

Genesis moved byte-identically into a dedicated canonical bootstrap namespace. The package root remains a compatibility shim, the governed AI runtime bootstrap mirror stays byte-identical, and AIFT-GENESIS now follows the canonical source path.

The provider-neutral contract moved byte-identically into a dedicated canonical providers namespace. The root module remains a compatibility shim; skeleton/provider_runtime.py remains owner-sensitive in place but now imports the canonical contract. The AI providers contract mirror remains byte-identical and its mapping source follows skeleton/providers/contract.py.

The duplicate KV-cache facade was collapsed onto the existing canonical skeleton.kv package surface. The root and legacy AI sibling remain compatibility shims; AIFT-KV-CACHE now binds identical canonical package __init__ files. This wave also removes the stale AIFT-NATIVE jvm_registry.py overlay exclusion after TREE-008 made that file part of both native trees.

Classified the final previously-unmentioned skeleton top-level runtime roots without moving code: frontier receives an explicit canonical frontier-runtime zone; pipelines joins build/Forge delivery ownership; platform joins simulation as the Godot adapter boundary.

The two-file Godot adapter package moved into canonical simulation ownership. godot_adapter.py moved byte-identically; the canonical package and AI simulation mirror are tree-identical. Legacy skeleton/platform remains compatibility-only, AIFT-PLATFORM follows the canonical path, and the parent AIFT-SIMULATION platform overlay was retired because platform is now present in both governed trees.

Nineteen generation-pipeline modules moved under canonical Forge ownership. Eleven internal references were rewritten to skeleton.forge.pipelines; eight modules moved byte-identically. The canonical package is mirrored exactly at skeleton/ai/forge/pipelines, the legacy root remains compatibility-only, AIFT-PIPELINES follows the canonical path, and the parent AIFT-FORGE pipelines overlay was retired.

The two-file engine-neutral creator intent compiler moved under canonical Forge ownership. intent_compiler.py moved byte-identically; package self-imports were rewritten to skeleton.forge.creator; the canonical creator subtree and AI Forge mirror are exact. AIFT-CREATOR follows the canonical path, and AIFT-FORGE no longer requires any overlay children.

Sixteen Frontier runtime/control-plane modules were extracted into skeleton/frontier/runtime/. Internal runtime imports and public frontier exports now target the nested canonical paths; flat module paths remain compatibility shims. The same transformation was applied to skeleton/ai/runtime/frontier, preserving exact whole-tree and runtime-subtree parity.

Twelve Frontier progression/meta-game modules were extracted into skeleton/frontier/progression/. Internal progression/runtime references and public frontier exports now target canonical nested paths; flat module paths remain compatibility shims. The same transformation was applied to skeleton/ai/runtime/frontier, and biotope_achievement_adapters now imports canonical progression/runtime dependencies. Whole-tree source/AI parity remains exact.

Eight Frontier ecology/lifecycle modules were extracted into skeleton/frontier/ecology/. Internal ecology/runtime/progression references and public frontier exports now target canonical nested paths; flat module paths remain compatibility shims. The same transformation was applied to skeleton/ai/runtime/frontier, and cooking_adapters/gameplay now consume canonical ecology paths. Whole-tree source/AI parity remains exact.

Eight Frontier economy/production modules were extracted into skeleton/frontier/economy/. Five modules had internal runtime/ecology/economy imports rewritten to canonical nested paths; crafting.py, energy.py, and equipment.py moved byte-identically. Public frontier exports now target the canonical economy modules, flat module paths remain compatibility shims, and the same transformation was applied to skeleton/ai/runtime/frontier with exact whole-tree parity.

Three Frontier NPC/character modules were extracted into skeleton/frontier/characters/. npc.py and npc_profiles.py moved byte-identically; npc_adapters.py now imports the canonical character module. Public frontier exports target the nested paths, flat module paths remain compatibility shims, and the identical transformation was applied to skeleton/ai/runtime/frontier with exact whole-tree parity.

The final three large Frontier gameplay/world modules were extracted into skeleton/frontier/game/. ship.py and world.py moved byte-identically; gameplay.py now consumes canonical ecology/economy paths. Public frontier exports target the nested ship/world modules, flat gameplay/ship/world paths remain compatibility shims, and the identical transformation was applied to skeleton/ai/runtime/frontier with exact whole-tree parity.

The two-file Lorebuffa-derived domain-knowledge package moved byte-identically under canonical simulation ownership. The legacy root remains compatibility-only, AIFT-CONTENT follows skeleton/simulation/content, and the parent AIFT-SIMULATION content overlay was retired after exact governed-tree parity verification.
